title: Affine koszul signed dual coefficient square
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an affine open, A=Γ(Y,U), I an ideal of A, n a natural number and f:Fin n→A. Let T be associated sheafification transported from Spec A to U and TC its termwise functor on integer cochain complexes. Let E=TC(K_A(f) extended with K_q in degree -q) [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex]. There exist complex isomorphisms bO:D(E,T(A))≅TC(koszulDualComplex extended upwards) and bQ:D(E,T(A/I))≅TC(koszulQuotientDualComplex extended upwards). They satisfy D(E,T(A→A/I))≫bQ.hom=bO.hom≫TC(extended koszulCoefficientReduction). Here D is [def-sc-signed-sheaf-dual-complex], its coefficient map is [new-g3-signed-sheaf-dual-coefficient-map], and the dual complexes and coefficient reduction are [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex] and [new-j3-koszul-quotient-coefficient-complex]. No regularity hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Use the finite exterior-power bases to prove each Koszul term is finite free. Apply the degreewise affine Hom comparison family to the Koszul chain complex with coefficients A and A/I. Its first naturality identity supplies compatibility with every chain boundary; its second supplies compatibility with the quotient coefficient map.

Conjugate the term comparisons by extendXIso in nonnegative degrees. The scalar identity -(-1)^q=(-1)^(q+1) converts the signed sheaf boundary into the module boundary. Use zero objects for negative degrees; the degree -1 source is zero. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents assembles the two complex isomorphisms. Compare the coefficient composites degreewise: negative degrees have zero source, and positive degrees use extendMap_f, interchange of pre- and postcomposition, the coefficient naturality equation, and cancellation of the extension isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_koszul_signed_dual_coefficient_square
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens) (I : Ideal (Γ(Y, U.1)))
    (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)) :
    let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
    let TC := T.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let E := TC.obj
      ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A n f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
    ∃ (bO : signedSheafDualComplex (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
          E (T.obj (ModuleCat.of A A)) ≅
        TC.obj ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulDualComplex A n f).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
      (bQ : signedSheafDualComplex (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
          E (T.obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))) ≅
        TC.obj ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulQuotientDualComplex A I n f).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)),
      signedSheafDualCoefficientMap E (T.map (ModuleCat.ofHom I.mkQ)) ≫ bQ.hom =
        bO.hom ≫ TC.map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap
          (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulCoefficientReduction A I n f)
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
